scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run watch -w @supports/shared" "npm run dev -w @supports/api" "npm start -w @supports/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @supports/api && npm run build -w @supports/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @supports/shared && npm test -w @supports/api
